decision.comment: HH_260906 - Freeze a fresh paired legacy-data development ablation before any new training outputs, without redefining data admission.
decision.purpose: Train all model parameters with and without supplied acceleration values. This is not STOP-decision or stop-primitive training.
decision.schedule_change: Run exploratory learning now on the unchanged legacy v3 corpus while independent qualified-data collection remains unresolved; do not present it as the previously proposed fresh-qualified-corpus comparison.
decision.known_data_limits: Preserve all warmup anchors, target deceleration violations and labels. Legacy absence of denial markers is not new quality approval. Exclude every denied 2026-09-08 C-track collection.
decision.budget: Six fresh fits, 1540 steps and batch4 each. Five complete train1147 epochs plus 105 batches (6155 sample exposures per fit), not ten epochs. No resumed or reused baseline, validation-epoch selection or failed-seed removal.
decision.candidate_screen: Both selected ADE and FDE must improve in all three paired seeds; selected geometry pass count must not fall, and selected speed MAE must not rise more than 5 percent in any pair.
decision.test_policy: Full-corpus contract/hash validation may read held-out test JSON and JPEG bytes. Test samples are excluded from model training loss, model inference, evaluation metrics and model selection.
decision.promotion: Never automatically promote, change runtime-bundle allowlists, relax physical/runtime gates or actuate a vehicle. Existing shadow checkpoint and every failed result remain intact.

publication_notice: Redacted metadata view; replay requires the private original identified by raw_source_sha256.
